current_boundary.qualified_device_state: gravity_glm_router_select_noaux_f32 writes eight stable score-ranked expert IDs and aligned normalized weights to pool.expert_idx and pool.expert_w.
remaining_host_work: commit and wait after the router gate plus device selection
download 8 u32 IDs and 8 f32 weights, 64 bytes per sparse layer
validate IDs and append them to GlmTrace
sort the eight router slots by ascending expert ID
construct 8 routed expert names plus one shared-expert name
admit and pin the selected gate/up/down tensors in the name-keyed LRU
bind concrete Metal buffers into gate/up/down dispatches
current_boundary.why_bytes_are_not_the_boundary: The synchronization and host-created resource identity, not the 4,800 bytes, prevent the router and expert work from sharing one command segment.

gpu_weight_cache.admission: ensure_many_locked loads missing tensors and calls admit_pinned with the current host-known name set
gpu_weight_cache.eviction: least-recently-used name outside the current call pin set
missing_capabilities: no logical (layer, expert, projection) device address index
no admission or eviction delta for patching an address table
no in-flight pin lease that outlives a cache mutex guard
no device-visible miss generation or ready mask

gpu_tensor.pq: two Metal buffers, codebooks and padded packed codes, plus 32-byte PqParams
gpu_tensor.native_bf16: one Metal buffer plus rows and cols
gpu_tensor.consequence: The current Math-Preserve routed population is heterogeneous; an expert descriptor must be tagged and cannot assume every selected expert is gravity-pq.

token_command_buffer.shape: one-shot MTLCommandBuffer wrapper with direct compute dispatches and a consuming commit_and_wait
token_command_buffer.resource_addressing: dispatch closures may call useResource/useResources, but TokenCommandBuffer has no resource lease or persistent resource argument table

argument_buffer_support.KernelArgBuffer: a shared MTLBuffer for packed scalar U32/F32/U64 fields; it is not an MTLArgumentEncoder-backed resource table
argument_buffer_support.existing_resource_pattern: the Qwen megakernel writes Buffer::gpu_address values into repr(C) structs and calls use_resources for every indirectly referenced Buffer
argument_buffer_support.applicability: This raw-address plus useResource pattern is sufficient for a bounded expert-table proof without first implementing an ICB.

icb_support.metal_crate: metal 0.29 exposes IndirectCommandBuffer creation, indirect compute command mutation, and pipeline supportIndirectCommandBuffers descriptors
icb_support.repository: no ICB construction, execution, GLM pipeline, or TokenCommandBuffer integration exists
icb_support.pipeline_gap: MetalContext::pipeline uses new_compute_pipeline_state_with_function and never opts a pipeline into ICB support
icb_support.binding_gap: the vendored metal 0.29 wrapper exposes execute_commands_in_buffer on the render encoder but no compute-encoder wrapper; compute execution would need a binding addition or explicit Objective-C message
icb_support.architectural_limit: An ICB schedules commands but cannot make an absent evictable expert tensor addressable.

expert_wave.admission: pre-admits all gate/up/down names for the selected routed experts plus shared expert
expert_wave.dispatch: concrete per-name gate/up, SiLU, down, then axpy in host-supplied ascending expert order with shared last
expert_wave.measured_status: default-off and rejected for performance at 1,413 ms versus 828 ms, despite passing its correctness gates
expert_wave.reuse_boundary: its persistent scratch and encode-only math primitives are reusable, but its host prefix loop and concrete Buffer binding are the boundary under audit

whole_model_headroom.verdict: Naive all-candidate residency is not viable on the 96-GiB host.

selected_route_bounds.authority: checked-in Math-Preserve header-only census; the exact token scalar remains route-conditioned

proposed_device_descriptor_for_compariso.fields: primary_address u64, secondary_address u64, eight u32 geometry fields, kind u32, generation u32
proposed_device_descriptor_for_compariso.composition: three DeviceTensorRef values plus ready mask and padding
proposed_device_descriptor_for_compariso.qualification: A concrete comparison ABI, not existing runtime code. Compile-time Rust/Metal size and alignment assertions are required in implementation.

a_all_expert_argument_buffer.preserves_exact_order: yes, if the router emits an ascending execution permutation and combine consumes that order with shared expert last
a_all_expert_argument_buffer.layer_scoped_variant: Pre-admitting all 256 triplets only for the current layer fits the 32-GiB budget, but sequential 75-layer LRU reuse would cold-touch up to 86.657 GB per token and retains a host layer-admission boundary.
a_all_expert_argument_buffer.verdict: Reject as a production next slice. Metadata is cheap; required residency or cyclic upload is not.

b_cache_indexed_argument_table_patched_b.underlying_weight_bytes: bounded by the existing explicit cache budget
b_cache_indexed_argument_table_patched_b.removes_selected_id_boundary: yes on a table hit; no on a cold or evicted selected triplet
required_safety: a table entry becomes ready only when all gate/up/down resources are present
the device checks ready mask and generation before dereferencing any raw address
an immutable per-command table snapshot or lease prevents host patching while a command is in flight
every indirectly referenced Buffer is declared with useResource and kept alive through completion
eviction clears or advances generation only after the prior lease completes
b_cache_indexed_argument_table_patched_b.miss_contract: The device writes missing logical expert IDs or a miss mask, suppresses expert/residual mutation, and the host admits, patches, then replays from an unchanged pre-layer state.
b_cache_indexed_argument_table_patched_b.verdict: Only admissible incremental design. It is boundary-free on resident hits and remains exact on misses; it cannot honestly promise unconditional boundary removal while weights remain host-loaded and evictable.

c_gpu_icb.address_metadata_bytes: driver-defined and not derivable without constructing an ICB; underlying expert resources still dominate
c_gpu_icb.underlying_weight_bytes: same as option a for unconditional execution, or same hit/miss constraint as option b
c_gpu_icb.removes_selected_id_boundary: only after selected resources are already addressable
c_gpu_icb.preserves_exact_order: possible by encoding selected commands in the ascending execution permutation
c_gpu_icb.repository_gap: No GLM ICB, ICB-enabled pipeline, compute execute binding, persistent command graph, or TCB integration exists.
c_gpu_icb.verdict: Not the minimum change. ICB is a later replay/encode-overhead mechanism, not a solution to cache misses or resource identity.

d_packed_per_layer_expert_arena.heterogeneous_layout_requirement: separate tagged R4, R0, and native-bf16 banks plus offsets; one uniform PQ arena is not valid for Math-Preserve
d_packed_per_layer_expert_arena.streaming_variant: Keeping only one layer arena resident is bounded but touches or uploads the full 86.657-GB candidate population per token and cannot form a boundary-free whole-token graph.
d_packed_per_layer_expert_arena.artifact_requirement: The current loader exposes separately named tensor payloads and separate Metal buffers. A true no-copy contiguous arena requires a new packed artifact layout or a large runtime copy.
d_packed_per_layer_expert_arena.verdict: Best eventual direct-index ABI only if artifact layout and memory policy change; not an additive runtime slice.

architectural_conclusion.unconditional_statement: No evaluated option simultaneously guarantees zero host boundary on a cold selected expert and preserves the current lazy bounded host-loaded LRU. An absent tensor must be admitted by some host or storage mechanism before the GPU can execute it.
architectural_conclusion.qualification: It removes the selected-ID boundary on resident hits and retains an exact miss boundary. Claiming unconditional removal would require all-candidate residency, a GPU-accessible packed artifact with demand paging, or another storage architecture.

exact_next_implementation_slice.scope: Default-off, one sparse-layer cache-hit correctness slice; no ICB and no artifact change.
steps: Extend the qualified router kernel to write a second eight-slot execution permutation sorted by ascending expert ID while leaving its score-ranked diagnostic IDs and aligned weights unchanged.
Add a repr(C) tagged DeviceTensorRef and ExpertTriplet table ABI with compile-time Rust/Metal size and alignment checks.
Under the existing GpuWeightCache mutex, build one immutable 45,056-byte layer-table snapshot from currently resident entries and clone/lease every Buffer named by ready entries.

Add a selected-expert device kernel or small kernel chain that reads pool.expert_idx, pool.expert_w, the ascending execution permutation, and the layer table; it must check all ready generations before raw-address dereference.
Reuse ExpertWaveScratch for gate/up/act/down/combined outputs, but combine routed outputs in the device-provided ascending expert order and add shared expert last.
Call use_resources for every leased indirect Buffer and hold the cache guard or an explicit ExpertTableLease until the TokenCommandBuffer completes.
Copy the eight diagnostic IDs into a 75-by-8 device trace buffer and reconstruct GlmTrace only after the token's final wait; do not reintroduce a per-layer trace readback.
On any table miss, write a miss mask and leave residual state untouched. The first slice should return a typed miss before mutation; a follow-up adds host admit-and-replay.
proof_fixture: prewarm exactly the fixture's selected routed triplets and shared expert
encode router selection through selected gate/up, SiLU, down, ordered combine in one TokenCommandBuffer
assert zero selected-ID and selected-weight mid-layer readbacks
assert exact router IDs, ascending execution permutation, shared-last order, and final greedy/top-k under Numeric Parity V2.1
evict one selected triplet and assert a fail-closed miss with byte-identical pre-layer residual
assert resident bytes never exceed the configured LRU budget and no leased resource is evicted before completion
explicit_non_goals: performance claim from the previously rejected expert-wave

falsifiers: Any raw expert address is dereferenced when its ready mask or generation is stale.
A table hit still downloads selected IDs or weights before expert dispatch.
A miss mutates residual, scratch interpreted as output, KV, router history, or trace before replay.
Routed outputs are accumulated in score order rather than ascending expert-ID order, or shared expert is not last.
An indirectly referenced Buffer lacks useResource or can be evicted/freed while the command is in flight.
The candidate raises the cache budget, preloads all 256 experts per layer, or touches more weight extent than selected triplets plus the shared expert on a hit.
ICB is presented as solving absent resource admission.
The default path or default-off flags change.
